reading_note: The teaching describes the full arc of regeneration: divine truth (the First Man) clothed in five discrete degrees of reception (the five garments, each containing five powers — twenty-five faculties); the descent of divine influx (the Call) meeting the ascent of reception in the soul (the Answer); their conjunction in the regenerate person (twenty members of the Grand Man); the lifting of the soul out of the works of evil; and the resulting fifty-day cycle (Pentecoste) of spiritual nourishment, fasting from natural appetites, and the doubling into a hundred holy days through Jesus the Splendor — divine truth itself becoming the living food that fills with power, riches, life, and light. The arc moves from clothing-in-degrees → call-and-answer → conjunction → ascent → sustained living food → fullness.
